events.title: Vue.js publicly released
events.summary: Evan You released Vue.js in February 2014 — a progressive framework extracting Angular's data binding without the weight.
events.about: Vue offers reactive data binding, single-file components, and optional routing/state (Vue Router, Pinia) — adopt incrementally on existing pages or build full SPAs. Popular in Laravel stacks, Chinese tech ecosystems, and teams wanting React-like ergonomics with gentler learning curve.

narrative.whyChosen: Vue became the third pillar of modern frontends alongside React and Angular.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved a progressive, incrementally adoptable framework could compete with all-in SPA platforms.
narrative.problemSolved: AngularJS felt heavy for quick prototypes; You wanted reactive templates and components in a small package.
